list.subtitle: {{count}} devices
list.emptyHint: Register your first attendance terminal or connect a vendor cloud account. Punches start flowing as soon as the device is online.

fields.codeHint: Unique within the organisation; letters, digits, - _ . (max 32)
fields.timezoneHint: Defaults to the branch timezone; punches are interpreted in this zone.
fields.serialPushHint: Printed on the terminal; the device identifies itself with it when it contacts FlowZa.
fields.tagsHint: Free labels for filtering (e.g. gate, hq, floor-2).
fields.offlineThresholdHint: Minutes without a heartbeat before the device is reported offline.
fields.autoSyncHint: Pull attendance on a schedule (pull-capable providers only).

actions.restartUnavailable: Remote restart is declared by the provider but not exposed by the API yet.

sync-attendance.title: Sync attendance on {{count}} devices
sync-attendance.hint: A pull job is queued for every selected pull-capable device. Devices without attendance pull are skipped.

sync-employees.title: Push employees to {{count}} devices
sync-employees.hint: Every active employee of the device's branch is pushed. Devices without employee push are skipped.

health-check.title: Health check {{count}} devices
health-check.hint: Contacts each device and updates its connection status.

assign-group.title: Assign {{count}} devices to a group
assign-group.hint: Branch-bound groups only accept devices of that branch.

groups.title: Device groups
groups.subtitle: Group terminals to sync, filter and report on them together.
groups.deleteHint: Devices stay registered; only the grouping is removed.
groups.emptyHint: Create a group (e.g. "Head office gates") and add devices to it to sync and filter them together.
groups.noMembers: No devices in this group yet
groups.allDevicesAdded: Every device is already in this group.

pending.title: Devices waiting to be claimed
pending.hint: These terminals contacted FlowZa with an unknown serial number. Claim them to start receiving punches.
pending.none: No unclaimed devices have contacted FlowZa.
pending.noMatch: No pending device matches that serial.
pending.claimHint: Serial {{serial}} ({{provider}}) will be registered as a push device in the selected branch.

wizard.title: Register device
wizard.subtitle: Connect a terminal or vendor cloud account in a few steps.
wizard.invalid: Please complete the required fields before registering.
wizard.testQueued: A connection test has been queued for the new device.

stepHint.provider: Choose the manufacturer and integration you want to connect.
stepHint.model: Optionally pick the exact model to preload its capabilities.
stepHint.details: Identify the device and place it in a branch.
stepHint.connection: Enter the connection settings the provider needs.
stepHint.test: Check that FlowZa can reach the device before saving.
stepHint.review: Confirm the details and register the device.

wizard.placeholderNote: Integration not implemented yet — this provider cannot be registered.
wizard.modelHint: Picking a model preloads the verified capability matrix. You can skip this step.
wizard.noConfig: This provider needs no connection settings.
wizard.pushStep1: Register the device here to obtain its push URL and token.
wizard.pushStep2: Enter the URL and token in the terminal's server / cloud settings.
wizard.pushStep3: The device appears online after its first heartbeat.
wizard.pushTestHint: Push devices cannot be tested from here: the terminal must contact FlowZa first. Register it, configure the URL and token on the device, and watch for the first heartbeat on the device page.
wizard.throttling: Provider limits: {{perMinute}} requests/min, {{perDevice}} concurrent per device.
wizard.maskedHint: Stored value {{masked}} — leave empty to keep it.

test.hint: Uses the settings entered above; secrets are never stored by the test.
test.title: Connection test

push.title: Push credentials
push.onceHint: Copy these now — the token is shown only once and cannot be retrieved later.
push.instructions: Enter the URL and token in the terminal's server settings (or the vendor's webhook configuration). Rotating the token invalidates the previous one immediately.

employees.emptyHint: Push employees to the device or run a reconciliation to load its user list.

logs.emptyHint: Connection attempts, sync runs and push traffic are logged here.

commands.emptyHint: Commands are queued when employees are pushed to a push device and delivered on its next heartbeat.

detail.disableHint: Scheduled syncs stop and the device is skipped by bulk actions. Punches already received are kept. You can re-enable it later.
detail.decommissionHint: Pending commands expire and stored credentials are deleted. The device can no longer be reactivated — register it again if needed.
detail.rotateHint: The current token stops working immediately. You will need to update the terminal with the new token.
detail.notActiveHint: This device is {{status}}. Sync actions are unavailable until it is active again.

settings.endpointWarning: Changing the endpoint deletes the stored credentials — you will be asked to enter them again.
settings.credentialsRequired: The endpoint changed: enter the credentials again to restore the connection.
settings.credentialsHint: Secrets are stored encrypted and shown masked; enter a value to replace it.
settings.noCredentials: This provider has no secret settings.
settings.pushNoCredentials: Push devices authenticate with the push token; there are no credentials to store.
settings.dangerHint: Disabling keeps the device; decommissioning is permanent.
settings.readOnly: You do not have permission to change device settings.
